subject: Decision Making
title: Augmented Reality Decision Layers
description: A 60-second lesson on Augmented Reality Decision Layers.

hook.text: Imagine glasses that display calorie counts over restaurant food, credit scores over business partners.

buildup.text: Augmented reality overlays digital information onto the physical world.

discovery.text: Surgeons already use AR to see MRI data overlaid on patients during surgery.

twist.text: AR could also overwhelm. Too much visible data creates the same information overload that already plagues digital.

climax.text: AR decision layers demand new design rules. Show the right data at the right moment, nothing more.

punchline.text: Glasses that show calories, ratings, and risks. Every glance becomes a decision.

quiz.question: How could AR improve real-world decisions?
options: By overlaying relevant data directly onto physical objects at the moment of decision
